test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The incorrect spelling is: **Tastimonial**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word incorrectly spelled in the given list is "Tastimonial".
 
• The correct spelling for what seems to be the intended word is **"Testimonial"**.
 
• A testimonial is a formal statement testifying to someone's character and qualifications or to the benefits of a product (प्रशंसापत्र).
 
 
• Example: "The website featured testimonials from satisfied customers who had used the service."
 
 

Therefore, the spelling error is: ***Tastimonial.*****
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **ballad** is a simple song, especially one that tells a story (गाथागीत).

 
 
• Example: "The folk artist sang a haunting ballad about lost love."
 
 
 
• **Rampant **means flourishing or spreading unchecked (अनियंत्रित).
 
 
• Example: "Corruption was rampant in the city, affecting all levels of government."
 
 
 
• A **beneficiary** is a person who derives advantage from something, especially a trust, will, or life insurance policy (लाभार्थी).
 
 
• Example: "His niece was the sole beneficiary of his estate."

The correct answer is: Option 3**.
